executable_actions.on_failure: Retain the result as a current verification-capability failure, recording each missing or mismatched tensor/layer/hash/shape/DDR-stream/consumption edge in the produced ledger and SACG handoff. Do not fabricate semantic evidence, alter golden outputs or tolerance, run dependency-blocked board simulation, substitute a wrapper, reopen lower layers, or promote. A later valid current board trace may be localized only after this gate passes.
executable_actions.rationale: Repair only the existing exact-board loader/harness binding path and its auditable ledger for every target-layer Transformer-block tensor. Generate or reconcile a complete immutable-checkpoint catalog with explicit DUT-scope classification, then bind each required tensor hash through tensor identity, shape/packing, DDR placement, AXI stream/beat order, loader transaction, and DUT-consumption witness. Preserve the target checkpoint, stimulus, target-model reference outputs, numeric policy/tolerance, semantic-testbench contract, and exact user-supplied board-wrapper/Vivado-export source hashes. This is the earliest executable board-layer capability repair; it is not an RTL correctness repair and excludes all model-tail work.

observations: The decisive current executed failure is real_tool.case_multilayer_pipeline: the exact-board DUT binding does not cover every in-scope Transformer-block weight in every target layer. All board VCS, AXI/DDR, protocol, DDR-roundtrip, deadlock, multilayer-functional, and semantic-evidence gates are dependency-blocked rather than hardware failures.

Debug closure classifies the failure as a verification semantic-capability gap, reports no failed boundary or root RTL module, and explicitly blocks a hardware boundary trace until loader/weight-binding capability is repaired.

The connected-kernel replay is closed hash-bound evidence: its CCTG replay passed with 416 accepted records, complete 1792-beat ingress/egress lifecycle, terminal egress last, and preserved elastic pipeline boundary order. No current board trace directly contradicts these named invariants, so neither connected-kernel replay nor leaf-module reopening is authorized.

The historical VCS diagnosis is explicitly historical_only because a live source hash changed. Its output-frontier symptom is not current direct core-boundary contradiction evidence and cannot reopen the connected kernel.

The conditional design-team review returned no_split and supplies no alternate action. SACG-memory truth has 17 active contamination barriers and 6 open retry requests in this scope, including retry_request.0136 and retry_request.0140; rejected Stage7/Stage8 artifacts remain planning/debug evidence only. There are no scoped open backtrack requests.
proposed_actions: Perform one bounded exact-board loader/harness binding repair and fresh failed-gate rerun. Only a hash-bound pass of case_multilayer_pipeline may unblock subsequent current-layer AXI/DDR verification; do not schedule a connected-kernel replay, RTL-core repair, VCS run, or backend action in this decision.
risks: Model/scope risk: a catalog that omits a target Transformer-block tensor, or includes model-tail tensors as DUT requirements, invalidates weight coverage. The repaired ledger must classify the complete checkpoint and require all and only accelerator-scope tensors.

Shape, data-order, and memory risk: each tensor hash must be tied to its target-layer identity, shape/packing, DDR address region, AXI beat ordering, loader transaction, and a DUT-consumption witness; a manifest on disk without this chain is insufficient.

Numeric-policy risk: checkpoint, stimulus provenance, target-model expected outputs, resolved frozen tolerance, and semantic-testbench contract must remain immutable. This static binding repair must neither generate expected outputs from RTL/random data nor loosen tolerance.

Runtime, implementation, and board-fact risk: the repair must bind the current exact user-supplied wrapper and source/Vivado-export identity hashes, not a simplified wrapper or guessed simulator command. Any proposal that changes DDR layout, address map, wrapper ABI, pipeline architecture, or numeric policy requires separate approval.

Even a fresh pass of case_multilayer_pipeline establishes only prerequisite semantic coverage. It does not clear active contamination barriers, prove board output progress, or authorize backend/bitstream/runtime promotion.

constraints: immutable checkpoint, stimulus, target-model reference, numeric policy, tolerance, semantic-testbench contract, and exact board-wrapper source hashes
Transformer-block-only DUT scope; embedding/tokenization, final norm, LM head/logits, and sampling are excluded
edges: board_current_trace -> lower_layer_reopen only when it directly contradicts a named certified invariant

output.summary: Fail-closed: repair only the current exact-board multilayer weight-loader/binding capability and rerun case_multilayer_pipeline. No board functional, AXI/DDR, liveness, numeric, or DUT-correctness pass exists, and no current trace permits reopening the certified connected kernel or leaf layers.
